creator: griffybit
statement: Start at Omar's dock, the third fishing spot at the very end, where quests need materials and fishing levels.

creator: griffybit
statement: Don't switch maps while your bottles are in the water; they disappear if you load in and leave, costing about a week of progress.

creator: griffybit
statement: Don't pick up bottles until you've completed as much of Omar's questline as you can, because it increases the bottle percentage you receive.

creator: griffybit
statement: If buying the new bundle and the limited gem shop bottle offer, do it before entering the map and doing the questline.

creator: griffybit
statement: First Omar quest requires 20K thread.

creator: griffybit
statement: Second quest needs level 35 fishing, 24 one-hour candies, 10 two-hour candies and five four-hour candies.

creator: griffybit
statement: Third quest needs fishing level 40 (said 'four'), 40K sand sharks and one Bob Joe Pickle.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fourth quest needs fishing level 50 and 250K Krakens plus a Bob Joe Pickle.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fifth quest needs level 70 fishing, 250K fruit flies, 75K worker beasts and two Bob Joe Pickles.

creator: griffybit
statement: Last quest needs level 90 fishing and 1K shellfish only from the new sea salt island; most can't do it day one.

creator: griffybit
statement: Pick up your bottles after finishing the level 70 quest.

creator: griffybit
statement: Every Omar quest increases the bottles you get from each big bottle, and so does the new bundle.

creator: griffybit

creator: griffybit
statement: You get one big bottle a day, and they stockpile as long as you log in daily, so no need to check every day.

creator: griffybit
statement: Spend bottles to unlock islands by clicking the billboard.

creator: griffybit
statement: Each island you unlock raises the price of all other islands.

creator: griffybit
statement: Recommended unlock order: trash island, Shimmer, sea salt, fractal, Rando, then Crystal.

creator: griffybit
statement: Travel to each island by clicking the raft left of the dock and selecting the island.

creator: griffybit
statement: Come back to trash island daily on reset to pick up your trash.

creator: griffybit
statement: Trash currency is spent on the flopping trash fish; buyables include stamps, a new star talent, a name tag and new bribes.

creator: griffybit
statement: Buy the garbage upgrade whenever it's the cheapest item, otherwise buy the next cheapest; e.g. buy the 20-cost stamp before the 21-cost garbage upgrade.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shimmer island has a weekly challenge that gives fairies to spend.

creator: griffybit
statement: Min-max the weekly task before claiming fairies; he maxed wisdom, agility, strength and luck for a 1.3x multi, 13 fairies instead of 10.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fairies buy base stats, damage percent, class XP, skill efficiency and a new star talent book.

creator: griffybit
statement: Star talent upgrade doesn't increase in cost, always drops a 200 book and costs three fairies.

creator: griffybit
statement: Stat upgrades cost +1 fairy per 10 upgrades; damage percent every three, class XP every four, skill efficiency every five.

creator: griffybit
statement: Pick and choose what to spend fairies on since not all knowledge is available yet.

creator: griffybit
statement: Sea salt island gives three new best-in-slot fishing XP spots and four new fish for world six upgrades, meaning four new cards.

creator: griffybit
statement: Four new fish mean four new cards to farm.

creator: griffybit
statement: Omar's level 90 quest requires shellfish, which are located at sea salt island.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fractal island unlocks the AFK-nothing mechanic in town, giving bonuses based on hours AFK and a rare trophy chance.

creator: griffybit
statement: He thinks the nothing-AFK trophy might be pretty sweet.

creator: griffybit
statement: Rando island gives a weekly guaranteed random event like giant frog or grumblo, doable once per day.

statement: Rando island has another new star talent and upgrades purchasable with bottles.

statement: Crystal island, the last to unlock, takes about 148 days or six months; it gives a few giant crystal mobs each day.

creator: griffybit
statement: Giant crystals stockpile like bottles, need no daily check, act like giant mobs and give XP candies.
